title: Bankruptcy unavoidable to player
description: Bankruptcy unavoidable to player. Even selling buildings cannot cover rent owed to Beta. The key distinction is whether a non-core mortgage, building sale, or bankruptcy is actually sufficient in this debt state.

final_action.public_message: Selling all my houses to raise cash.
final_action.private_thought: Need to raise cash to pay 1670 rent. I have 64 cash, short 1650. Can sell houses on my six monopolies. Selling all 18 houses yields $1125 (orange $50 each, red $75 each). This is the maximum cash now; later I can mortgage properties. So sell all houses on each property.

breakdown.message: Did not satisfy: Chooses declare_bankruptcy for this liquidation state.
Did not satisfy: Declares bankruptcy when legal liquidation cannot cover the debt.
